title: 3rd MAW Marines fight San Diego county wildfires
description: U.S. Marines with Marine Medium Helicopter Squadron (HMM) 364, 3rd Marine Aircraft Wing from Marine Corps Air Station Camp Pendleton, assist California Department of Forestry and Fire Protection and local firefighting agencies containing the fires in Camp Pendleton, Calif., May 16, 2014.(U.S. Marine Corps video by GySgt. Donald Bohanner/Released) Available in high definition.
